Zanzibar for Families

Family-friendly experiences, activities, and accommodations for an unforgettable Zanzibar holiday with children.

Why Zanzibar for Families

Family-Friendly Highlights

Zanzibar offers a perfect blend of safe beaches, engaging activities, and cultural experiences that cater to travelers of all ages. From gentle water activities to wildlife encounters, there's something for every family member.

Safe Swimming Beaches

Calm lagoons and protected beaches ideal for children, including Paje's shallow waters and Nungwi's gentle shores. Many hotels offer kids' pools and supervised activities.

Turtle Experiences

Turtle nesting season (January-March) and hatching experiences are magical for children. Visit Nungwi or Jambiani for ethical turtle encounters.

Spice Farm Tours

Interactive spice farm visits are educational and engaging for kids. Touch, smell, and learn about Zanzibar's famous spices in a hands-on setting.

Cultural Experiences

Stone Town's winding alleys and historic sites provide fascinating cultural exposure. Visit the Old Fort, House of Wonders, and Freddie Mercury House.

Kid-Approved Activities

Top Activities for Children

Mnemba Snorkeling

Calm waters and vibrant coral reefs make this suitable for beginner snorkelers. Many operators offer family-friendly trips with short durations and provided equipment.

Dolphin Watching

Early morning trips from Kizimkazi offer high success rates. Ethical operators maintain safe distances and follow responsible wildlife viewing guidelines.

Beach Horseback Riding

Available along the south and east coasts. Shorter rides are available for children, with safety equipment provided.

Cultural Village Visits

Interactive visits to local villages offer insights into Swahili culture, traditional crafts, and daily life. Children can participate in cooking demonstrations and craft workshops.

Family-Friendly Accommodations

Recommended Stays for Families

Resorts with Kids' Clubs

Several all-inclusive resorts offer supervised children's programs, allowing parents some relaxation time while kids engage in age-appropriate activities.

Boutique Hotels

Smaller properties often provide personalized family service and can arrange child-friendly dining, babysitting services, and tailored excursions.

Beach Bungalows

Self-catering bungalows offer flexibility for families with specific routines, kitchen facilities for preparing familiar foods, and private beach access.
